raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Reject unsupported block types inside Anthropic `tool_result.content` before message conversion. The adapter handles `text`, `image` and `tool_reference`; other nested blocks currently disappear while the request still succeeds.

The validator returns a bad request for unsupported nested types and preserves supported content. This is separate from top-level validation in #47747/#47877 and nested-image support in #35557.

## Validation

Current head: `38f92049`, merged through main `06f36c12`. The conflict was at the end of `test_messages.py`: both our nested-content rejection test and main's server-tool rejection test are retained. The validator and our regression functions have the same AST as `e099bfd7`; the PR still adds 82 lines across four files.

- The existing `TestToolResultContent` suite passes with normal global fixtures on macOS CPU:
  ```sh
  VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
    tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_anthropic_messages_conversion.py::TestToolResultContent
  # 12 passed
  ```
- Collection succeeds for both streaming variants of `test_unsupported_nested_tool_result_returns_bad_request` and main's `test_anthropic_server_tool_is_rejected` (three collected cases). This checks collection, not HTTP execution.
- Scoped Ruff/format checks and `git diff --check` pass. The normal commit hooks passed for the merge-conflict file, including test tethering and mypy.

Earlier baseline/patched protocol imports showed five unsupported payloads accepted before/rejected after while six supported forms stayed unchanged. The earlier single-GPU vLLM 0.29 compatibility server returned 200 before/400 after for nested documents in both streaming modes, with valid requests still 200. Those are historical protocol/compatibility results, not a current-head target-checkout serving or model run.

The original human line review and protocol replay preceded initial publication. No new human-run tests are claimed. Full target-checkout serving coverage remains for upstream CI:

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_messages.py::test_unsupported_nested_tool_result_returns_bad_request
```

## CI refresh

The merge conflict is resolved on `38f92049`. Current-head pre-run-check and DCO have passed; pre-commit and the docs build are pending at this update. The required `buildkite/ci/pr` status has not appeared for this head. Earlier Buildkite results apply to their own commits.

Prepared with Codex assistance.

files.patch:
@@ -80,3 +80,11 @@ If the model responds correctly, your setup is working. You can now use Claude C
 **WebSearch fails with `tool type 'web_search_...' is not supported`**: Claude Code's WebSearch tool relies on Anthropic's server-side web search tool, which runs on Anthropic's servers. vLLM does not run server tools and rejects requests that include them with a 400. Use an MCP server that provides web search instead.
 
 **Model not found**: Ensure the `--served-model-name` matches the model names in your environment variables. You cannot use model names with `/` in them, such as `openai/gpt-oss-120b` directly from Huggingface, so beware of that limitation with Claude Code.
+
+### Tool result content
+
+The Messages API accepts strings or lists of `text`, `image`, and `tool_reference`
+blocks in `tool_result.content`. Nested block types that the adapter cannot
+represent, including `document` and `video`, return a bad-request error instead
+of being silently removed. Convert unsupported tool output to supported text or
+image blocks before sending it.

@@ -276,6 +276,25 @@ def _make_tool_result_request(
             ]
         )
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        "block",
+        [
+            {"type": "document", "source": {"type": "text", "data": "report"}},
+            {
+                "type": "video",
+                "source": {"type": "url", "url": "https://example.com/a.mp4"},
+            },
+            {"type": "thinking", "thinking": "hidden"},
+            {"type": "unknown"},
+            {},
+        ],
+    )
+    def test_unsupported_nested_content_is_rejected(self, block):
+        with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match="Unsupported tool_result.content"):
+            self._make_tool_result_request(
+                [{"type": "text", "text": "A report follows"}, block]
+            )
+
     def test_tool_result_string_content(self):
         request = self._make_tool_result_request("file contents here")
         result = _convert(request)

@@ -245,6 +245,50 @@ async def get_stream_usage(resp):
     assert warm_usage.cache_read_input_tokens > 0
 
 
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
+async def test_unsupported_nested_tool_result_returns_bad_request(
+    client: anthropic.AsyncAnthropic, stream: bool
+):
+    with pytest.raises(
+        anthropic.BadRequestError, match="Unsupported tool_result.content"
+    ):
+        await client.messages.create(
+            model="claude-3-7-sonnet-latest",
+            max_tokens=1,
+            stream=stream,
+            messages=[
+                {
+                    "role": "assistant",
+                    "content": [
+                        {
+                            "type": "tool_use",
+                            "id": "call_1",
+                            "name": "read_file",
+                            "input": {},
+                        }
+                    ],
+                },
+                {
+                    "role": "user",
+                    "content": [
+                        {
+                            "type": "tool_result",
+                            "tool_use_id": "call_1",
+                            "content": [
+                                {"type": "text", "text": "Read this report"},
+                                {
+                                    "type": "document",
+                                    "source": {"type": "text", "data": "report"},
+                                },
+                            ],
+                        }
+                    ],
+                },
+            ],
+        )
+
+
 @pytest.mark.asyncio
 async def test_anthropic_server_tool_is_rejected(client: anthropic.AsyncAnthropic):
     with pytest.raises(anthropic.BadRequestError) as exc_info:

@@ -96,6 +96,17 @@ class AnthropicContentBlock(BaseModel):
     # For tool_addition/tool_removal content
     tool: "AnthropicToolChange | None" = None
 
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def validate_tool_result_content(self) -> "AnthropicContentBlock":
+        if self.type == "tool_result" and isinstance(self.content, list):
+            for index, item in enumerate(self.content):
+                if item.get("type") not in ("text", "image", "tool_reference"):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"Unsupported tool_result.content[{index}] type: "
+                        f"{item.get('type')!r}; expected text, image or tool_reference"
+                    )
+        return self
+
     @model_validator(mode="after")
     def validate_tool_change(self) -> "AnthropicContentBlock":
         if self.type not in ("tool_addition", "tool_removal"):
